review_evidence: README identifies lean-smt as a Lean tactic framework translating goals to SMT solvers and reconstructing solver proofs, with support for uninterpreted functions, arithmetic, quantifiers, and experimental bitvectors.

The primary source includes tactic/reconstruction implementation and an extensive Test tree whose examples state axioms and prove nontrivial propositions using the smt tactic; representative Demo.lean proves group-style identities.
Test/issue/playground modules therefore carry concrete formal statements and regression prior art, so FILTER-011 forbids path-based removal and no lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain lean-smt's implementation and test corpus; test modules contain checked theorem statements and reconstruction examples.
